title: DESIGN-LAB interop: DTCG design-token document (DL-P0-110)
description: Structural contract for a Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) 2025.10 token document. Groups are objects whose non-'$' members are tokens or nested groups; a token is an object carrying '$value'. Semantic rules that this schema cannot express -- $type inheritance, alias resolution, alias-cycle rejection, composite member completeness and per-type value shape -- are enforced by design_lab.interop.dtcg.validate_document.

token.description: A DTCG token: an object that carries $value. $type is optional at the token when an ancestor group declares it.

$extensions.description: Free-form vendor extension map (DTCG reserves this key for tools).

group.description: A DTCG group: an object whose non-'$' members are tokens or nested groups. $root carries the group's own value.

rootGroup.description: The document root is a group. It may additionally pin the DTCG schema URL; a top-level $root token is not supported because it has no flattened path.
